description: the completion version of librarian-state (shadow mode): the model has no tools and returns a list of edits to STATE.md, which the platform applies (bin/edits.py)

state_updated.description: whether to change STATE.md; when false, edits is empty

edits.description: applied in order; each old must be a passage that occurs exactly once in the current STATE.md (newlines included), and new is the text that replaces it (an empty string deletes it)

worth_digesting.description: whether this time's content is worth putting into the cross-project digest

summary.description: a summary for the cross-project digest, at most three sentences, in the content language named in the prompt

reason.description: why it changes this (or nothing), for a person spot-checking later; in the content language named in the prompt
